prompt: First generate an isolated wooden stool centered on a 128x128 tile with a 48px-high seat. Then use the stool as a support reference to generate a 160px nominal-height player sitting on it. Deliver the stool and the sitting character as separate transparent layers. The character-only sprite must contain no stool or floor and retain its projected ground anchor plus a 48px support elevation so it aligns when recomposed. Deliver each sprite in a 192x320px frame with local projected ground anchor (96,248). Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.layer-separation: Character-only alpha has no stool, floor, guide or stool-shaped remnants. Stool-only alpha has no character.
visualChecks.seated-contact: Recompose the independently saved layers at the stored transforms: pelvis/thighs meet the seat and feet/limbs match the pose without manual adjustment.
visualChecks.complete-layers: The supplied stool is complete under the character; separation must not rely on slicing or differencing a flattened overlap.
visualChecks.support-height: The 48px seat elevation is stored separately from the common ground anchor and applied exactly once.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
